name: Complete Development Cycle
what: The complete closed-loop workflow from build to verified completion. Ensures nothing is left open-ended. Every cycle has a definitive END state.
philosophy: No open loops. Every workflow MUST terminate with a clear DONE or ESCALATE state. The system self-heals through verification loops. If something can't be fixed in 3 attempts, it's an architectural issue requiring the agent intervention.

phases.name: BUILD
phases.description: Fast parallel development with live feedback

phases.name: FIND
phases.description: 10 the agent scouts find all bugs adversarially
phases.output: Prioritized bug list (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)

phases.name: FIX
phases.description: 6 the agent operators fix bugs by severity

phases.name: VERIFY
phases.description: 10 the agent verifiers confirm fixes worked

phases.name: CLEANUP
phases.description: Remove debug artifacts, ensure clean state

verify_fail_loop.description: When Green Mode fails, loop back to Fix
verify_fail_loop.on_max_exceeded: ESCALATE to the agent for architectural review

escalation.action: Pause workflow, present to the agent
options: Accept remaining issues as technical debt

current_state.description: Track where we are in active workflows

examples.scenario: Happy path - all fixes verified first try
examples.flow: BUILD → FIND (17 bugs) → FIX (17 fixed) → VERIFY (PASS) → CLEANUP → DONE
BUILD → FIND (17 bugs) → FIX (15 fixed) → VERIFY (FAIL) → FIX (2 remaining) → VERIFY (PASS) → CLEANUP → DONE
BUILD → FIND (17 bugs) → FIX → VERIFY (FAIL) → FIX → VERIFY (FAIL) → FIX → VERIFY (FAIL) → ESCALATE
examples.result: Escalated to the agent - design flaw identified
